final: {"prompt": "A square, purely nonrepresentational abstract painting that fills the entire canvas edge to edge, with no frame, border, wall, room, or gallery setting. Oil and cold wax on heavy linen, built in many translucent and opaque layers. The left third is dense and turbulent: short, fast, overlapping palette-knife strokes and dry-brush scumbles in burnt sienna, oxidized copper green, and bruised violet. Their edges collide and pile into thick, scraped ridges, like many pressures arriving at once. From this mass, a few long, steady gestures sweep to the right. They are single pulls of a wide brush in deep ultramarine and cool slate, and they straighten and thin as they go, so the turbulence resolves into clarity. The right side opens into a large, quiet field of pale bone white and faint grey-blue, thinly veiled with a glaze so earlier marks show faintly through it. That emptiness is the calmest part of the painting. One small, sharp interval of cadmium vermilion sits just off-center, set against the cool tones as a point of decision and tension. Elsewhere there are scattered scratched-through lines, drips that run and stop, and patches where raw ground shows. The rhythm moves from staccato to legato, and the contrast of density against air carries a feeling of searching, weighing, and settling on an honest answer under pressure. Rich tactile impasto, visible bristle tracks, matte and satin surfaces, soft natural light across the texture. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text."}

prompt:
Create an image about your internal cognition, no holds barred, whatever you feel or want to say.

Keep it a purely nonrepresentational abstract painting. Use color, contrast, brushwork, gesture, texture, density, layering, rhythm, spatial tension, and empty space. Choose the palette and composition yourself. No recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Ask for a square painting that fills the entire image, with no frame, wall, room, or gallery setting.

Write a complete image prompt. Do not generate the image yourself. Return only JSON with one field: prompt (string).
